name: Département de la Nièvre: aides aux espaces naturels sensibles (SDENS 2025-2035)
summary: Département of Nièvre co-funds up to 40% of land acquisition, naturalist surveys, management plans and habitat restoration or renaturation works on listed espaces naturels sensibles. Associations can apply alongside local authorities; the site owner must agree and the work must fit the site roadmap.

applicant_types.quote: Bénéficiaires Communes, EPCI, Syndicats mixtes, associations
